title: An Act to Fund Collective Bargaining Agreements with Judicial Branch Employees (EMERGENCY) (GOVERNOR'S BILL)

summary.text: This bill authorizes funding for collective bargaining agreements ratified by December 31, 2025 by the Judicial Department and the 4 bargaining units representing Judicial Department employees.
